name: ChapterLeads - Two Leads, One Without A Role
description: The named-leads block as a chapter page renders it. The pair is the point: the role line is per-lead, so one lead with a role and one without is the only arrangement that shows both branches in a single frame. A chapter with no leads renders nothing at all, which is why this seeds two rather than relying on the empty default. Worth knowing when reading this frame: the heading is the site's shared eyebrow and is uppercased by CSS, so the component's default heading - changed from 'Chapter Leads' to 'Chapter leads' by the sentence-case standard - is NOT visible here. It reads CHAPTER LEADS either way. The case of that default is settled in source and by the sentence-case guard test, not by this screenshot.
